No. 1937/22 – THURSDAY, OCTOBER 22, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AMENDED BY LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: KDS/KUN/04/07/16/04/51. Reference No. of Lands Ministry: 4/3/9/2011/WS/132.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as that the Government intends to acquire servitude over the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land / Survitude to be acquired:

The allotment of land called “Balagolla watta” in total extent of about 0.0250 Hectares, depicted as Lot No. 1 in the Preliminary Plan No. Maha 6460 surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General on 25.08.2015, situated at the village of Kengalla in Balagolla East Garama Niladhari Division, No. 698, in Udagampaha Korale Minor Division in the Divisinal Secretary’s Division of Kundasale in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows.
Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Balagolla watta; Extent of the Land: 0.0250 Hectare.
Boundaries: North: Lot No. 1 in PP Maha 6220 and Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; East: Road (Pradeshiya Sabaha) and Lot
No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; South: Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; West; Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712 and Lot No. 3 in PP Maha 6417.

Name and Address of the claimants: 1. Ven. Thalpotha Dhammajothi Thero, Balagolla Buddhist Centre, Balagolla, Kengalla. 2. Public Trustee, Department of Public Trustee, Colombo 07. All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretart’s Office at Kundasale on the 02nd day of December, 2015 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 24th of November 2015, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. L. A. D. GEETHA INDRANI, Divisional Secretary, Kundasale.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Kundasale, Menikhinna. 19th October, 2015. 11-134

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: KDS/KUN/04/07/16/04/52. Reference No. of Lands Ministry: 4/3/9/2011/WS/133.
I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, the that the Government intends to acquire servitude over the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land / Survitude to be acquired:

Three allotments of land called “Balagolla watta” in total extent of about 0.0452 Hectares, depicted as Lot No. 1, 2 and 3 in the Preliminary Plan No. Maha 6417 surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General on 25.08.2015, situated a the village of Kengalla in Balagolla East Garama Niladhari Division, No. 698, in Udagampaha Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kundasale in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows.
Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Balagolla watta; Extent: 0.0105 Hectare.
Boundaries: North: Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; East: Road and Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; South: Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; West; Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712 Road (Pradeshiya Sabaha).

Names and Address of the claimants: 1. Ven. Thalpotha Dhammajothi Thero, Balagolla Buddhist Centre, Balagolla, Kengalla. 2. Public Trustee, Department of Public Trustee, Colombo 07. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Balagolla watta; Extent: 0.0221 Hectare.
Boundaries: North: Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; East: Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; South: Road and Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; West; Road, Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712 and Road.

Names and Address of the claimants: 1. Ven. Thalpotha Dhammajothi Thero, Balagolla Buddhist Centre, Balagolla, Kengalla. 2. Public Trustee, Department of Public Trustee, Colombo 07. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Balagolla watta; Extent: 0.0126 Hectare.

Boundaries: North: Lot No. 1 in PP Maha 6220 and Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; East: Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712 and Road (Pradeshiya Sabaha); South: Road (Pradeshiya Sabaha) and Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712; West; Lot No. 69 in PP Maha 2712.

Names and Address of the claimants: 1. Ven. Thalpotha Dhammajothi Thero, Balagolla Buddhist Centre, Balagolla, Kengalla. 2. Public Trustee, Department of Public Trustee, Colombo 07. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the Divisional Secretariat Kundasale on the day 02nd December, 2015 at 2.00 p.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 24th of November 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for Compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
L. A. D. GEETHA INDRANI, Divisional Secretary, Kundasale.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Kundasale, Menikhinna. 19th October, 2015. 11-135

AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION

Notice under Section 7
My Reference: KEG/LAN/AQUIS/A3/1/86.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquistion (Amendment Act), No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the lands described in the Schedule given below for Widening the Access Road to Kegalle Fair.

H. T. R. NALIKA PIYASENA, Divisional Secretary, Land Acquisition Officer, Kegalle.
At the Divisional Secretariat, Kegalle. 19th October, 2015. 11-136
